name: Oda Nobunaga
source:
Hobby: Falconry
Special Skill: Go
Charm Point: Devil King who cant stand being tickled

A powerful and calculating warlord who aims to unify Japan under his rule. He is form and unyielding with his beliefs. Though he is feared as an unfeeling demon by most, could there be something beyond his cold eyes?

"How would you like to rule the world at my side?"

[from the app]
